rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a professional comedian or humorous entertainer.

example.english: That comedian is doing stand-up at the Coliseum tonight.
example.traditional: 嗰個搞笑藝人今晚喺紅館講棟篤笑。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gaau2 siu3 ngai6 jan4 gam1 maan5 hai2 hung4 gun2 gong2 dung3 duk1 siu3

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring specifically to a professional comedy actor or performer.

example.english: This comedian won an award for this film.
example.traditional: 呢位喜劇演員憑呢套戲攞咗獎。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 hei2 kek6 jin2 jyun4 pang4 ni1 tou3 hei3 lo2 zo2 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this for anyone who is funny or amusing, rather than specifically a professional entertainer.

example.english: You really are a comedian; you always make everyone laugh.
example.traditional: 你真係個搞笑嘅人，成日都令大家笑。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 gaau2 siu3 ge3 jan4 sing4 jat6 dou1 ling6 daai6 gaa1 siu3
